attBesluta.text: We took it to the Ozarks for the Shoot out. Never had to get back in the boat once. Holds Ice GREAT!

This cool was a hit on the river, two trips down and this bad boy just like new, held drinks for a group of 8, ice lasted the trip no issue, bonus we always stop off for a swim, in the past had to drag the tubes out so they didnt float away, no more, pulled the cooler out of the water and ot was our anchor, tubes stayed in the water, next bonus it work out nicely strapped to my quad for around the property when its not floating... cant wait for our kayak trip next week...
Love this cooler! Works excellent! Use it every time I take the boat out now!

Fiquei muito satisfeita com este produto, exatamente como é descrito. Entrega rápida e eficaz, tudo correu bem sem problemas, a empresa muito profissional e confiável, já fiz várias compras sem problemas, tudo cinco estrelas

This thing is amazing, we got it for our swimming pool. It will hold a ton of drinks. I would recommend getting the one with wheels as it is pretty big and bulky. People were using it as a float in the pool. I added a bottle opener tied to it which helped as well. Highly recommend...

I love the idea of this dispenser. My only complaint would be the spout is just a little too low. I know it needs to sit at the edge of the counter or on a stand to dispense. But it can’t sit completely on the counter for filling etc. because the spout sits lower than the bottom and then the jug then sits one side raised balancing on the spout. Overall though, it’s a great dispenser
